scope: Q3 from-scratch round3; B and round2 CR frozen

sequence: add directional candidates and event triggers
add compatible witnesses as separate increment
phase2.initial_witness_mode: record only; veto threshold decided on development and frozen before new tests

new_tests.shrink_rule: Before any new test run, halve BOTH sizes to64/48 if measured projected total CPU exceeds6h or cumulative development CPU exceeds2.6h; never drop individual cases

acceptance.correctness: all clear, certified exit, no real truth access, budgets
acceptance.conflicts: report separately, no weighted winner score

regret.primary_tail10: mean of largest ceil(0.1*n) max(r,0), including zero padding
regret.additional: top ceil(0.1*positive_count) positive regrets, and all individual maxima
regret.bootstrap_unit: original shared base map; average variants within group for mean differences

report: physical and strengthened plus robust validation lower bounds
